analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 44.2. MACD histogram shows improvement but lacks a confirmed trend reversal signal. ADX at 31.0 indicates a clear trend, but the DI indicators show a selling bias (-DI 31.9 vs +DI 23.1), making the trend direction uncertain. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 1.21, within normal levels. Current price of $79,400 is below the swing resistance of $80,380. With a stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($10,000) from the entry price of $79,400, a stop at $69,400 and target at $95,000 (risk-reward ratio > 1.5) is technically feasible, but maintaining a cautious stance due to uncertain trend direction.
